about.title: About draft() — and how it differs from other Draft apps
about.desc: draft() by ipe Studio is a voice-first storytelling app. How it differs from other apps that share the name Draft.

p: Many apps and tools use the name “Draft”. draft() on this site is a different product: a voice-first storytelling app made by ipe Studio. You talk for about thirty seconds, answer two or three gentle questions, and get a finished story — hook, rising action, peak, reflection and close — while your words stay yours.

sections.h: How to tell it is ours
li: The name is written draft(), with parentheses, and marked “an ipe studio app”.

privacy.title: Privacy — draft()
privacy.desc: How draft() and draft.ipe.rest handle your data: what we promise, what is still being finalized, and how this website works, including its visit statistics.

li: Your words are yours — never sold.
You decide what is kept, and what is deleted.
Only the finished story is shared — when you choose to.

sections.h: In the app: still being finalized
p: draft() is still being prepared, so some details are not final, and we will not guess here. Before launch we will confirm each of these and publish them on this page:
li: How your speech is turned into text, and whether that happens on your device or with a service.
How long stories and drafts are kept, and how you delete them.
What usage statistics the app collects, if any.
How subscriptions and payments are handled through the App Store.
How to contact us about your data.
Whether your words are ever used to train or improve anything — to be confirmed before launch and published on this page.
Visits are also counted with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which is cookieless and does not collect personal data.
Fonts load from Google Fonts, so your browser contacts Google’s font servers.
Your language choice is remembered in your browser only (local storage) and is never sent to us. Until you choose, the home page follows your browser’s language setting.
To opt out, block or delete cookies in your browser settings, or use Google’s [Analytics opt-out add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). The site works the same without them.
There are no accounts on this site, and it collects no forms or personal details.
p: This section is only about this website. What the app collects is covered in the app section above.

We use Google Analytics 4 to see which pages are read. It records page views, the page you came from, your browser and device type, an approximate location (country or city) and clicks on links that leave our site (the link address only). It sets cookies in your browser (such as `_ga`, which can last up to two years) to tell visits apart. We do not ask for your name or email in analytics, and we cannot identify you from it. Google processes this data on our behalf, which can include servers outside Korea.
A contact address for privacy questions will be published here at launch.
